title: SetSurrogateRelativePose
description:
Sets the relative position and orientation of the 
			surrogate with respect to its starting point on the containing vehicle.  For example,
			specifying a relative Z position of 100m indicates the surrogate should move to a point
			that is 100m above its starting (home) position on the vehicle.  This command is not
			used to launch or recover a surrogate, but only to command a surrogate after it is 
			already launched - attempting to use this command to launch or recover the surrogate
			shall yield an error response.  Relative pose is defined as a position and orientation
			relative to the Host Frame of reference, as defined in Section 3 Common Conventions.

RelativePoseExtRec.comment: Relative pose is defined as a position and orientation relative to the Host Frame of reference, as defined in Section 3 Common Conventions.
